sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of 2048 Number Ball are simple yet addictive. The game takes place on a 4x4 grid, divided into 16 spaces. Players start with two tiles, each with a value of 2. The objective is to merge adjacent tiles with the same value to create a new tile with a higher value. The game uses a simple yet effective formula to determine the value of the new tile: the value of the two tiles is added, and the result is divided by 2.

As players progress through the game, new tiles will appear on the grid at random, adding an element of chance to the gameplay. The game ends when a player has merged all the tiles to create a single tile with the value of 2048, or when there are no more moves left on the grid. In the latter case, the game is lost, and the player must start over.

One of the key features of 2048 Number Ball is its use of tiles with different values. The game starts with tiles with a value of 2, but as players progress, the tiles will have values ranging from 4 to 2048. This adds an element of strategy to the game, as players must carefully plan their moves to maximize their chances of success.
